Eclipse (Lunar)

entries.description:
Balance
Force of Nature grants 3 charges of Dream Burst, causing your next Wrath or Starfire to explode on the target, dealing [(393% of Attack Power) * 1.06] Nature damage to nearby enemies. Damage reduced above 5 targets.
Restoration
When Grove Guardians are summoned, they grow Dream Petals on your target, healing up to 3 nearby allies for (146.4% of Spell Power).

entries.name: Treants of the Moon
entries.description:
Balance
Your Force of Nature treants cast Moonfire on nearby targets about once every 6 sec.
Restoration
Your Grove Guardians cast Moonfire on nearby targets about once every 6 sec.

entries.name: Expansiveness
entries.description:
Balance
Your maximum mana is increased by 5% and your maximum Astral Power is increased by 20.
Restoration
Your maximum mana is increased by 5%.

entries.name: Protective Growth
entries.description: Your Regrowth protects you, reducing damage you take by 8% while your Regrowth is on you.

entries.name: Sylvan Beckoning
entries.description:
Approximately 1 procs per minute Balance
Entering an Eclipse summons a Dryad to assist you for 8 sec, casting Starsurge dealing (150% of Spell Power) Astral damage and Starfall at 250% effectiveness.
Restoration
Your periodic heals have a chance to empower your next Swiftmend to summon a Dryad to assist you, casting Tranquility at 10% effectiveness and Regrowth to heal (658.507% of Spell Power) damage onto your lowest health ally.

nodes.name: Power of Nature / Durability of Nature

entries.name: Power of Nature
entries.description:
Balance
Your Force of Nature treants no longer taunt and deal 300% increased melee damage.
Restoration
Your Grove Guardians increase the healing of your Rejuvenation, Efflorescence, and Lifebloom by 10% while active.

entries.name: Durability of Nature
entries.description:
Restoration
Grove Guardians last 20% longer.
Balance
Your Force of Nature treants have 100% increased health.

entries.name: Cenarius' Might
entries.description:
Balance
Entering Eclipse increases your haste by 6% for 6 sec.
Restoration
Swiftmend healing is increased by 20%.

entries.name: Grove's Inspiration
entries.description:
Balance
Wrath and Starfire damage increased by 10%.
Regrowth and Wild Growth healing increased by 9%.
Restoration
Wrath and Starfire damage increased by 10%.
Regrowth, Wild Growth, and Swiftmend healing increased by 9%.

entries.name: Potent Enchantments
entries.description:
Balance
Orbital Strike damage increased by 30%, and damage of Stellar Flares it applies increased by 30%.
Whirling Stars increases the haste you gain during Celestial Alignment by an additional 6%.
Balance (Incarnation: Chosen of Elune)
Orbital Strike damage increased by 30%, and damage of Stellar Flares it applies increased by 30%.
Whirling Stars increases the haste you gain during Incarnation: Chosen of Elune
Restoration
Reforestation grants Tree of Life for 6 additional sec.

entries.name: Dryad's Dance
entries.description:
Restoration
Dryads cause Swiftmend to cool down 25% faster.
Balance
Dryads cause most of your Astral power generation to be increased by 10%.

entries.name: Bounteous Bloom
entries.description:
Balance
Force of Nature Treants last 4 sec longer.
Restoration
Your Grove Guardians' healing is increased by 30%.

entries.name: Early Spring
entries.description:
Balance
Force of Nature cooldown reduced by 15 sec.
Restoration
Swiftmend and Wild Growth cooldowns reduced by 1 sec.

nodes.name: Power of the Dream / Control of the Dream

entries.name: Power of the Dream
entries.description:
Restoration
Dream Surge heals 1 additional ally.
Balance
Force of Nature grants an additional stack of Dream Burst.

entries.name: Control of the Dream
entries.description:
Balance
Time elapsed while your major abilities are available to be used or at maximum charges is subtracted from that ability's cooldown after the next time you use it, up to 15 seconds.
Affects Force of Nature, and Convoke the Spirits.
Restoration
Time elapsed while your major abilities are available to be used or at maximum charges is subtracted from that ability's cooldown after the next time you use it, up to 15 seconds.
Affects Nature's Swiftness, Incarnation: Tree of Life, and Convoke the Spirits.

entries.name: Blooming Infusion
entries.description:
Balance
Every 5 Regrowths you cast makes your next Wrath, Starfire, or Entangling Roots instant and increases damage it deals by 100%.
Every 5 Starsurges or Starfalls you cast makes your next Regrowth or Entangling roots instant.
Restoration
Every 5 Regrowths you cast makes your next Wrath, Starfire, or Entangling Roots instant and increases damage it deals by 100%.
Every 5 Starsurges you cast makes your next Regrowth or Entangling roots instant.
(100ms cooldown)

entries.name: Spirit of the Thicket
entries.description:
Restoration
Ironbark summons a Dryad to channel a beam of pure nature onto your target, healing them for (4392% of Spell Power) over 6 sec.
Balance
Your Starfall damage is increased by 18% and your Starsurge damage is increased by 8%.

entries.name: Harmony of the Grove
entries.description:
Balance
Each of your Force of Nature treants increases damage your spells deal by 4% while active.
Restoration
Each of your Grove Guardians increases your healing done by 5% while active.
